Name: Snow
Description: Control the snow cascades. Small variations will be added per cascade.

Name: Cascades
Description: The number of cascades, or periods of snowfall.

Name: Duration
Description: Controls the length of time snow accumulates on the terrain, affecting overall snow coverage and depth.

Name: Intensity
Description: Determines the rate at which snow falls and accumulates, influencing the thickness and density of the snow layer.

Name: Taper Snowfall
Description: Sequentially reduce the amount of snowfall per cascade.

Name: Taper Amount
Description: The amount to reduce in each snowfall period.

Name: Settle Duration
Description: Specifies the time it takes for freshly fallen snow to settle and compact, impacting the smoothness and stability of the snow surface.

Name: Melt
Description: Snow melts evenly across the entire terrain, resulting in a consistent reduction of snow coverage.

Name: Snow Line
Description: Defines the altitude or threshold below which snow does not accumulate, simulating natural snow lines on mountains.

Name: Advanced
Description: Specifies the minimum slope angle at which snow will slide off, affecting snow accumulation on steep surfaces.

Name: Slip-off angle
Description: Specifies the minimum slope angle at which snow will slide off, affecting snow accumulation on steep surfaces.

Name: Adhered snow mass
Description: Controls the amount of snow that remains attached to surfaces, even on steep or vertical terrain.

Name: Flows
Description: Create flow structures like furrows and grooves from sharp snow accumulation.

Name: Flows Depth
Description: The depth of the flow structures.

Name: Seed
Description: Sets the randomization seed for snow distribution, ensuring reproducible results or introducing variation in snow patterns.

Name: Sharp Buildup
Description: Forces sharp edges where large amounts of snow gets piled up.

Name: Alternate Snowfall
Description: Use an alternate algorithm to create snow cascades.

Name: Surface Details
Description: Add small surface details to accentuate snow buildup.
